note: Compiled from BADAN_MASTER_BLUEPRINT.md by scripts/mine-blueprint workflow. Source of truth for the app registry. (§25/26 Visual + interaction design)

primary.usage: global interactive accent: buttons, links, selected states (chosen calm teal; blueprint left global primary unspecified, uses per-pillar accents)
primary.note: derived — not literally in blueprint; verified WCAG AA (light 5.2:1 on white, dark high-contrast on base)

onPrimary.usage: text/icon colour for content painted on a primary-filled surface (save buttons, selected chips)
onPrimary.note: not literal white in dark mode — primary's dark value is a light teal, so white-on-primary measures ~2.07:1 (fails AA); this near-black teal passes (UIUX-223)

separator.note: blueprint specifies black@8% (light) / white@8% (dark); these are solid opaque equivalents

above.usage: out-of-band high — same amber as 'below'; direction shown by up-arrow + text, never red/green

below.usage: out-of-band low — same amber as 'above'; direction shown by down-arrow + text, never red/green

critical.usage: reserved; near-never used to preserve its power

logo.note: Selectable app-icon system, implemented in AppIconOption.swift + Assets.xcassets/*.appiconset. Visual rationale and full mockups (palette, wordmark, RTL screens) for the three underlying identities live in design/badan-three-design-directions.html — this block is the compiled summary, mirroring how palette/typography above were mined from the blueprint.

options.concept: نور = light. A dawn arc rising over a solid dot: sunrise over the body (بدن). The dot is the anchor and never turns red; the arc warms toward gold as the day settles into range. Single-stroke, calligraphic curve reads clean at 20px.
Monoline stroke variant of the Noor dawn-arc mark — same identity, flatter/more graphic treatment.
Calligraphic-pen variant of the Noor dawn-arc mark, leaning into the قلم (pen/script) reading.

ميزان = balance / scale of measure. A calibration axis with a balanced beam and a centered node that doubles as the dot of ب (baa, first letter of بدن) — the body at the fulcrum of its own measurements. Monoline, on-grid, reads at status-bar/complication size.

هلال = crescent, cradled as negative space inside a khatam eight-point star (two overlaid squares) — Islamic geometric heritage rendered in a jewel emerald-teal gradient with a gold spark. Signals region-native premium identity without literal cliché iconography.

principles: Warm Instrument: pair precise, data-forward information with human warmth; dark-first but fully dual-theme from day one.
Never moralize state: no good/bad red-green — out-of-band uses one calm amber and direction is shown by an arrow plus text label.
Hue is never the only signal: every status pairs color with an icon and text, and all token pairs meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 graphics) in both themes.
Data-forward typography: tabular lining numerals everywhere values live, with Arabic/Eastern-Arabic digit parity per locale.
Calm by default: quiet, purposeful motion, no idle loops, and Reduce Motion honored globally.
Tactile and generous: soft 20pt card radii, layered surfaces, and a strict 44pt minimum touch target.
One model, two altitudes: casual and power are presentation policies over a single component library, not separate designs.
RTL and Arabic are first-order: chrome mirrors while time-axis plots stay LTR, tested across theme x direction x type-size.
